notes.title: Mouse Click Bug
notes.content:
Noticed a bug where the game would deselected what was hovered over in the pause menu and start menu if you clicked your mouse resulting in having to tab out of the game and tab back in to reset it. Should no longer have this issue anywhere in the game!

Thanks,
King Corg Games

notes.title: First Ever Hot Fix
notes.content:
Found bug where if you navigated the pause menu when a conversation was open, the conversation would continue to play.

Please let me know if anyone finds any other bugs! 

This is my first game so thanks for learning along with me!

Thanks,
King Corg Games
